summary.text: 请 means “ask” or “request,” and is also used for “invite” and the polite “please.” Its traditional counterpart 請 combines speech-related 言 with 青 as a sound element.

formation.text: The traditional graph 請 is phonosemantic: 言 supplies a speech-related meaning category, and 青 supplies the sound. The simplified form 请 retains this construction with 讠 in place of 言.

components.text: 讠 is the standardized simplified form of 言, the speech-related semantic component in 请. It is a component-form simplification, not evidence of a separate ancient replacement stage.
青 is the sound component identified in the traditional graph 請. Historical reconstruction supports a sound relationship; modern Mandarin similarity alone does not date its origin.

sound.text: 青 is qīng and 請 is qǐng in Mandarin; their readings are similar.
The Baxter–Sagart 2014 table gives 青 MC tsheng, OC *[s.r̥]ˤeŋ and 請 qǐng MC tshjengX, OC *[tsʰ]eŋʔ, a historical sound comparison within that reconstruction system.

history.text: A seal-style rendering provides a visual reference for 請, but it is a modern redraw rather than an ancient artifact. The historical analysis identifies 言 and 青 in the traditional graph; no dated sequence of earlier forms is established here.
请 is standardized as the simplified counterpart of 請, using 讠 for 言. This is a standardization relationship, not an ancient graphic chronology.

uncertainties.text: The historical gloss 謁也 is not enough to identify the earliest attested use, and no dated earliest specimen or graphic sequence for 請 is established here.

請 also has recorded qīng and qíng readings and uses, including 請室 and uses glossed as 通情 and 通擎. Their relation to qǐng, and the chronology of the recorded request, invitation, petition, inquiry, greeting, and respectful-request uses, remain unresolved.

senses.text: The character is used to ask, request, or entreat. These are recorded uses, but their earliest attestation is not established here.
Invite is a recorded use of 請; its chronology relative to asking or requesting is unresolved.
請 is also used for a respectful request, including as “please.” The evidence does not date this use or establish how it developed from other uses.
A historical lexicographic gloss is 謁也. This gloss does not establish the earliest attested use or a hypothetical original meaning.

limitations.text: The recorded senses include entreaty, engagement, invitation, petition, inquiry, greeting, welcoming a deity, and respectful request; their order and semantic connections are not established.
The separate qīng and qíng readings and uses are recorded, but their historical relation to qǐng is unresolved.

overview.text: 请 means “ask” or “request,” and also “invite” or “please.” In its traditional counterpart 請, speech-related 言 combines with 青 as a sound element; 请 uses the simplified form 讠 for 言.

components.text: 讠 is the simplified speech component corresponding to 言 in 請.
青 qīng and 請 qǐng have similar Mandarin readings, and Baxter–Sagart reconstructions also show a historical sound relationship.

relationships.text: 请 is the standardized simplified counterpart of 請, using the simplified component form 讠 for 言.
讠 is the speech-related semantic component in 请 and corresponds to 言 in 請.

青 is the stated sound component in 請. Mandarin 青 qīng and 請 qǐng are similar; Baxter–Sagart 2014 gives 青 MC tsheng, OC *[s.r̥]ˤeŋ and 請 qǐng MC tshjengX, OC *[tsʰ]eŋʔ, providing a historical comparison.
